name: Citalopram
metabolism: CYP2C19 and CYP3A4 mediate N-demethylation to demethylcitalopram, followed by further metabolism. Metabolites are substantially less potent than the parent; unchanged drug and metabolites contribute to urinary elimination.
summary: Citalopram is a selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SSRI) antidepressant used to treat major depressive disorder, obsessive-compulsive disorder, panic disorder, and social anxiety disorder.
